policy: DOCUMENT-ONLY mapping. No field renames applied to api/drugs.json in this cycle. Renaming alone does not fix the underlying type mismatches; coordinated rename + consumer update belongs to a future dev cycle.

success_rate.semantics: class-specific: AH=BP-control probability, Diabetes=A1c-goal probability, NSAID=pain relief >=50%, Statin=LDL-goal achievement (field name success_rate_ldl_goal)

onset.semantics: time to clinical onset; replaces type-inconsistent legacy onset_min (AH/NSAID int minutes, Diabetes string days|hours|weeks)

pregnancy_safety.classes: PPI, H2RA, Antacid, Alginate, Mucosal Protectant
pregnancy_safety.semantics: pregnancy category; NOTE schism: AH/Diabetes/NSAID/Statin carry this at top level, GI drugs inside l4_clinical (server.py reads top-level, making l4_clinical copy redundant)

ddi_burden.classes: PPI, H2RA, Antacid, Alginate, Mucosal Protectant

success_rate.semantics: probability of achieving BP control target

nnt_bp_control.semantics: A1c reduction efficacy — DIFFERENT shape from Antihypertensive (RISK 1 collision)

risks.title: nnt_bp_control semantic collision (false-sharing)
risks.detail: Antihypertensive {value,ci_95,dose} vs Diabetes {a1c_reduction,unit,dose} share the key; uniform-shape consumers crash on either class. Proposed fix: bp_efficacy / a1c_efficacy.

risks.title: onset_min type mismatch
risks.detail: AH/NSAID int minutes vs Diabetes string; arithmetic consumers crash on Diabetes. Proposed fix: structured onset {value, unit}.

risks.title: success_rate semantic ambiguity
risks.detail: Same field name, different endpoint per class; cross-class comparison invalid without class context.

risks.title: pregnancy_safety location schism
risks.detail: Top-level for AH/Diabetes/NSAID/Statin; inside l4_clinical for GI drugs; server.py reads top-level so l4_clinical copy is redundant.

risks.title: consumer breakage surface
risks.detail: api/server.py hardcodes 6 L4 field names (nnt_50_pain_relief, nnt_mace_5yr, duodenal_ulcer_healing_4wk_pct, onset_min, ee_healing_8wk_pct, du_healing_8wk_pct); _add_e3_e4_drugs.py uses nnt_bp_control/success_rate/onset_min. Renames must be coordinated with these.
